decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing Enigmatic Incarnation to tutor for powerful creatures while controlling the board with removal spells and Leyline Binding. The deck also includes a Companion, Yorion, Sky Nomad, to provide additional value and flexibility. By efficiently ramping and leveraging Enigmatic Incarnation's ability to tutor for specific creatures, the deck aims to establish board dominance and overwhelm the opponent with a wide range of threats. Additionally, the deck includes a variety of lands to ensure consistent mana production and smooth gameplay.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells in the early game to rapidly reduce their life total. The deck uses powerful synergy between creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Emberheart Challenger, along with burn spells like Fatal Push and Reckless Rage to maintain control of the board and deal direct damage to the opponent. Additionally, the inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds another layer of versatility to the deck, providing additional mana and a potential late-game threat.

This deck focuses on quickly building a strong board presence with aggressive human creatures that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. It utilizes cards like Thalia's Lieutenant and Collected Company to enhance the creatures and bring out additional threats. The deck includes a mix of low-cost creatures for early pressure and higher-cost creatures for added power. The mana base is designed to ensure consistent access to all colors needed for the human creatures. It aims to win the game quickly by quickly establishing a dominant board presence and attacking relentlessly.

The deck focuses on utilizing cheap, aggressive creatures like Emberheart Challenger and Monastery Swiftspear to deal quick and consistent damage to your opponent. By pairing these creatures with powerful pump spells like Titan's Strength and Monstrous Rage, you have the potential to overwhelm your opponent early in the game. Additionally, the inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides added versatility and consistency to your deck. The mana base of the deck is carefully constructed to support the aggressive playstyle, allowing for a smooth and efficient mana curve.

The deck focuses on utilizing Enigmatic Incarnation to tutor for powerful creatures and enchantments, creating a toolbox-style control strategy. Yorion, Sky Nomad serves as a companion for additional value. The deck includes various powerful creatures like Elesh Norn, Atraxa, and Skyclave Apparition, as well as enchantments like Leyline Binding and High Noon for disruption. It also includes a mix of lands to ensure mana consistency and options for fetching with Floodfarm Verge and Hushwood Verge. Overall, the deck aims to control the board and overwhelm opponents with powerful threats.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on efficiently dealing damage to the opponent through a mix of burn spells and aggressive creatures. The key concept is to quickly amass damage by utilizing low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Emberheart Challenger, while also having removal spells like Fatal Push and Reckless Rage to control the board. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with an early aggressive strategy, using cards like Kumano Faces Kakkazan and Heartfire Hero to close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on utilizing control elements such as removal, counterspells, and card advantage to control the pace of the game. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy and maintain a strong board presence with cards like Supreme Verdict and Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. The inclusion of Kaheera, the Orphanguard as a companion provides additional synergy with the creatures in the deck. The mana base is designed to support the control elements of the deck, with a mix of dual lands and utility lands to ensure consistency in casting spells.

This deck focuses on flooding the board with green creatures and generating massive amounts of mana through devotion to green. By ramping quickly with cards like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, the deck aims to play powerful threats like Polukranos Reborn and Cavalier of Thorns early in the game. The inclusion of cards like Storm the Festival and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner helps to maintain card advantage and pressure the opponent. With a strong mana base and efficient threats, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy.

The deck focuses on controlling the board using Enigmatic Incarnation to tutor for powerful creatures and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By utilizing a toolbox of creatures with varying abilities and utility spells like Torch the Tower and Chained to the Rocks, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and establish dominance over the game. With a mix of ramp, removal, and threats, the deck can adapt to different situations and maintain control throughout the match, ultimately overpowering the opponent with its versatile and powerful roster of cards.

This deck focuses on utilizing Lotus Field to ramp up mana quickly and efficiently, allowing for explosive combo plays. The main strategy involves using cards like Hidden Strings and Vizier of Tumbling Sands to untap Lotus Field multiple times in a turn, generating immense amounts of mana. The deck also includes toolbox cards like Fae of Wishes and Emergent Ultimatum to search for key combo pieces or answers to threats. By carefully managing resources and sequencing plays, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with powerful spells and game-winning combinations.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. The deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently, utilizing cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Kumano Faces Kakkazan to apply early pressure. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion adds an additional element of consistency and flexibility to the deck. Overall, this deck aims to outpace the opponent and close out games before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

The deck revolves around using Transmogrify to cheat out powerful creatures such as Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Hidetsugu Consumes All. It also includes various removal spells like Fatal Push and Torch the Tower to control the board. Thoughtseize and Duress are included to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Case of the Stashed Skeleton allows for graveyard recursion, while Reckoner Bankbuster and Bitter Triumph provide additional value. The deck also has a strong mana base with lands like Blackcleave Cliffs and Mutavault to support its game plan.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing a wide range of counter spells, removal, and card advantage. It also utilizes the companion Yorion to provide additional value through blinking permanents for extra triggers. The deck is built around maintaining control of the board while generating card advantage through cards like Memory Deluge and Omen of the Sea. Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Supreme Verdict provide additional control options, while the land base includes utility lands like Field of Ruin and Hengegate Pathway to further control the game.

This control deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy through a combination of counterspells, removal, and card advantage. It utilizes cards like No More Lies and Memory Deluge to draw cards and dig for answers, while also having board wipes like Settle the Wreckage and Supreme Verdict to deal with threats. The deck also includes planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Narset, Parter of Veils to provide additional card advantage and control elements. The goal is to outvalue and outlast the opponent by controlling the game and eventually winning through powerful late-game threats.

This UW Control deck focuses on controlling the board and hand with counterspells like Dovin's Veto and removal like Settle the Wreckage. The deck also includes draw power with Memory Deluge and card advantage with Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. Shark Typhoon provides a win condition while March of Otherworldly Light stalls the opponent. The deck also includes Kaheera, the Orphanguard as a companion for additional synergy. The mana base allows for flexibility and consistency in casting spells while Field of Ruin and other land destruction provide disruption to the opponent's strategy.
